WALL BOILER — SERVICE NOTES (transcribed from the paper manual in the hallway cupboard)

Normal cold system pressure: 1.2 to 1.5 bar.
If the gauge shows below 0.8 bar, refill through the grey filling loop under the boiler until it reads 1.3 bar, then close both taps.
Error code F22 means low water pressure. Error code F28 means the burner did not ignite.
Annual service is due every November. Filter in the return pipe: rinse it at every annual service.
